objective: 实现 Clash Verge 的大部分功能，包括各类右键菜单，并提供可正常使用的 ClashOS。
brandingDecision: Follow the user's later explicit spelling correction: ClashOS.
interpretation: Track the actual upstream feature categories and the user's top-navigation/branding requirements. Partial categories remain incomplete; this record is not a completion claim.

categories.latest: Core 0.32 installed. The final HAP passes independent on-emulator VLESS TCP/TLS/WS/WSS HTTP and SOCKS 204 controls and actual SOCKS5 UDP echo across empty/small/large/maximum packets. Saved VLESS profile/selection reload on cold start and visual override persists. Original saved profile, rule mode, all 11 group selections and full meaningful runtime settings restored; owned fixture profile/app/clipboard/forwards removed and window restored. Explicit Google HTTPS through the restored device proxy returns 204 / CONNECT 200 / TLS verification 0.
categories.limit: VLESS device proof uses a fixed independent ArkTS responder with a native TLS bridge; TLS-positive device fixtures explicitly skip the public test CA, and required-verification negative controls fail. Host-side independent OpenSSL peers separately prove CA/hostname acceptance and rejection plus verified HTTPS destinations. Reality/Vision/XUDP/extra encryption remain unsupported. Ordinary api.github.com domain connections had intermittent TLS failures in earlier controls; cause is still unproven. Full native suite requires loopback binding unavailable in this host sandbox. True-device TUN authorization/background survival remains unproven.
